## What's new

- Added "Paint mode", which allows you to quickly place and remove notes by just clicking and dragging your mouse around!
  - Toggle it through the "Paint mode" quick setting or hold its keybind to enable it temporarily (Default 'P')
- Turned the "Index" inspector value into "Hit Index", which counts hittable/visible notes only
- Added an extra icon and preview color for the "Friend" note :D
- Fixed imported UNANIMATED notes losing their actions 
- Fixed the osu cursor being captured incorrectly when not in fullscreen
- Fixed the "Prefer cover art" option not working

**Happy mapping!**
